purpose: Define independently AC-addressable Expose/Editor subareas so access to one editor or monitor does not implicitly grant access to all other human-facing configuration surfaces.

topics.name: Expose Access
topics.purpose: Define independently AC-addressable Expose/Editor subareas so access to one editor or monitor does not implicitly grant access to all other human-facing configuration surfaces.

semantics.segmentation_rule: Each subarea may have independent read/write/operation authorization.
semantics.inheritance_rule: Access inheritance occurs only through explicit AccessCore policy.
semantics.ui_rule: Hidden/disabled UI is presentation of authorization result, not the authorization mechanism itself.
semantics.backend_rule: Canonical operation enforcement remains authoritative even if a client bypasses UI presentation.
semantics.ac_off_rule: When AC is off, AccessCore restrictions do not apply.
semantics.ac_on_rule: When AC is on, each governed subarea follows its resolved policy.

invariants.rule: Web instances, protocol bindings and exposed surfaces retain explicit stable identity, binding, lifecycle and authority boundaries.

hard_gates.condition: access to Editor root automatically grants all subarea rights without explicit policy
UI hidden state used as sole security enforcement
client bypasses UI and canonical backend skips authorization
monitor read right implies editor write right
subarea authorization inferred from page nesting alone
